### Northern Decline Accelerates
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/northern-decline-accelerates
Passage: 2 Kings 14:23-29
Points:
- God demonstrated great long-suffering by preserving northern Israel despite roughly 150 years of continuous idolatry.
- Under Jeroboam II, Israel regained lost territory out of divine pity for the people's bitter affliction.
- Jeroboam's military successes were not earned by personal righteousness, but were gifts of God's unmerited mercy.
- Material wealth and national expansion during this era fostered greed and injustice rather than genuine repentance.
- God's willingness to show compassion should encourage believers to seek His forgiveness rather than take His patience for granted.

### Bible Pathways - May 6, 2009
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-may-6-2009-11603197.html
Passage: 2 Kings 14:23-27
Points:
- Jeroboam II reigned for forty-one years and restored Israel's borders, fulfilling the prophetic word given through Jonah.
- Scripture gives credit for these victories to God's intervention on behalf of a helpless and afflicted people.
- Although Jeroboam achieved notable military and political success, he persisted in doing evil before the Lord.
- Israel failed to recognize God's hand in their prosperity, choosing instead to credit idols and pursue moral compromise.
- Earthly security and blessings without true surrender to God ultimately lead to spiritual ruin.
